newsitem.title: UK: British women wait until 30s for babies - report.
newsitem.headline: British women wait until 30s for babies - report.

text.p: British women who wait until they are in their 30s to have babies now outnumber those who start families in their early 20s, the government said on Tuesday.
A survey published by the Office of National Statistics showed 90 live births per 1,000 women aged 30 to 34 in 1994, compared to 80 for women aged 20 to 24.
It also said that women in their late 30s were producing more children than teenaged girls for the first time.
Nonetheless, women in their late 20s continued to have the most babies, the report said.
Describing the change as "dramatic", the report said one reason was the sharp increase in women choosing to have children later, or not to have children at all.
It estimated that up to one in four women did not want children. But it said the fertility rate for women aged 35 to 39 had risen by 90 percent since 1970.
